body:
Continuation of incomplete draft PR #1165, roadmap Tasks 8–9. Depends on #1166 and #1168.

## Scope
- Rhythm desktop “Enable Mobile Access” diagnostics and QR flow
- Idempotent Tailscale Serve configuration via argument arrays, never shell strings
- iOS pairing route/provider/SecureStore token persistence
- Compatibility feature gating and independent cloud/Mac connection states
- Revoke and one-active-host replacement UX

## Acceptance
- Handles Tailscale missing/logged-out/wrong target/healthy states
- QR contains only tailnet gateway URL + one-time code
- Device token is Keychain-only; pairing code discarded after exchange
- States cover unpaired/pairing/connected/offline/Tailscale unavailable/revoked/incompatible/unhealthy
- Flutter format/analyze/tests and mobile tests/E2E pass
- Independent security/accessibility review passes
title: iOS: build desktop mobile-access flow and iPhone pairing UI
